create.name: Ethan Nichtern
create.bio:
Ethan Nichtern is a Buddhist teacher and writer from New York who presents classic Buddhist teaching in a direct, contemporary voice. He founded the Interdependence Project, a non-profit for secular Buddhist practice joined with the arts and social engagement, and has taught meditation and Buddhist psychology for many years in New York City and across North America and Europe. His books include The Road Home, a broad overview of the Buddhist path; The Dharma of The Princess Bride, which reads a much-loved film for lessons about friendship and relationships; One City, his first book on interdependence; and Confidence, an exploration of steadiness amid the eight worldly winds of gain and loss, praise and blame.

Much of his teaching now happens online. He leads a yearlong Buddhist studies programme of five six-week modules, taking students from the basics of the path through to emptiness and compassion, and he hosts The Road Home podcast, in which he talks with guests from the arts, science and spiritual life about practice in the real world. He also takes a small number of private students for at least six months of one-to-one meditation and study. He lives in Brooklyn with his daughter.

books.title: Confidence: Holding Your Seat Through Life's Eight Worldly Winds
books.author: Ethan Nichtern
books.description: Uses the Buddhist teaching on the eight worldly winds, the four pairs of opposites such as gain and loss or praise and blame, to show how to stay grounded in a shifting world. Funny and practical, with meditations along the way.

books.title: The Road Home: A Contemporary Exploration of the Buddhist Path
books.author: Ethan Nichtern
books.description: A broad, readable map of the Buddhist path for modern practitioners, from meditation basics to compassion and engagement with the world. With a foreword by Sharon Salzberg.

books.title: The Dharma of The Princess Bride
books.author: Ethan Nichtern
books.description: A playful look at friendship, love and relationship through Buddhist teachings, using the much-loved film as its frame.

books.title: One City: A Declaration of Interdependence
books.author: Ethan Nichtern
books.description: His first book, on the Buddhist idea of interdependence and what it means for how we live, consume and relate to one another.

courses.title: Yearlong Buddhist Studies 2027
courses.description: A year of live online study of the Buddhist path in five six-week modules, meeting on Tuesday evenings, with small practice groups between sessions. Modules can also be taken one at a time.

courses.title: Private Study with Ethan Nichtern
courses.description: One-to-one meditation and study guidance over at least six months, meeting in New York City or online. One-off meetings are sometimes possible.

free_resources.title: The Road Home Podcast
free_resources.description: His weekly podcast of conversations with guests from the arts, science and spiritual practice, exploring Buddhist teachings in everyday life.
